title: Kissed Crispy Middle-Eastern Yellow Pepper Wrap
description: A flavorful, crunchy wrap filled with roasted yellow peppers, topped with a hint of garlic and fresh herbs, perfect for a sunny brunch.

ingredients.name: Crumbly feta cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: optional for satvik-friendly, skip for vegan

instructions: Place the yellow bell peppers on a baking sheet, drizzle with a tablespoon of olive oil, and roast for 20-25 minutes or until the skin is charred.
Once the peppers are roasted, remove them from the oven and let them cool down. Peel off the skin, remove the seeds, and chop them into small pieces.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, chopped parsley, chopped mint, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
In a large pan, warm a tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic mixture and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the chopped bell peppers to the pan and stir to combine with the garlic mixture.
Warm the leaf wraps by wrapping them in a damp cloth and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a tablespoon of the garlic-bell pepper mixture onto each wrap, followed by a sprinkle of crumbled feta cheese (if using).
Serve the wraps immediately and enjoy!
